expiration_semantics: GET never mutates case state. Expired proofs/cases deny decision/execution immediately by authoritative clock. Next authorized same-Org mutating create/submit request may terminalize an already expired nonterminal case under org lock, with EXPIRE_CASE event and durable receipt bound to authenticated actor and deterministic child key from original request+expired case; never SYSTEM actor impersonation. This removes expired open-case unique conflicts atomically; replay adds no second expiry. No scheduler/job engine or client-supplied timestamp.
